channel.title: The Bridge India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Bridge India (thebridge.in)

item.title: Indian karting prodigy Atiqa Mir finishes top five on junior class debut
item.description: Eleven-year-old Atiqa Mir delivers a historic performance by breaking into the top five in the junior S125 category on debut.

item.title: Malaysian Open: Indian contingent targets impactful start to season's curtain-raiser- Preview
item.description: India has 12 entries across five categories in this first Super1000 tournament of the year, starting on January 6th.

item.title: Former world billiards champion Manoj Kothari dies at 67
item.description: The 1990 world champion and Dhyan Chand Award recipient passed away in Tirunelveli following a cardiac arrest.

item.title: Soorma Hockey Club notch first win of Women’s HIL season with victory over Ranchi Royals
item.description: Early strike from Penny Squibb and a second-half penalty stroke from Olivia Shannon help Soorma open their account in the league.

item.title: Manas Dhamne shocks fifth seed Matej Dodig on opening day of Bengaluru Open
item.description: Teenager Manas Dhamne delivers a breakout performance as Indian players make a strong start at the ATP Challenger event.

item.title: National Boxing Championships: Nikhat, Lovlina cruise through opening bouts
item.description: World and Olympic medallists begin their campaigns with dominant victories at the National Championships in Greater Noida.

item.title: Kane Russell hat-trick seals dramatic 3–2 win for HIL GC over SG Pipers in Men’s HIL
item.description: Late penalty corner completes Kane Russell’s treble as HIL GC snatch victory in a pulsating league opener.

item.title: Indian sprinter Dhanalakshmi Sekar handed eight-year ban for second doping offence
item.description: National Anti-Doping Agency sanctions former national record-holder after second positive test for anabolic steroid.

item.title: I was told to stop playing Football and get married | By Kaviya Pakkirisamy
item.description: Indian women footballer Kaviya Pakkirisamy opens up about fighting early marriage pressure, stitching torn boots to keep playing, and overcoming an ACL injury.

item.title: Malaysian Open: Lakshya Sen advances to second round; Malvika Bansod exits
item.description: Lakshya defeated Jason Teh Jia Heng of Singapore in a tough three-game affair.
